physicalAnchorReview.method: Manually observed posterior hip articulation; root x is its vertical projection. Ground y is complete recovered pose padded bottom (three-pixel extraction guard), except explicitly identified suspended poses using inspected grounded peers in the same source row. Tail, head and claw extrema never determine root x. Cropped offsets include negative source spill bounds.
